LightningComponentBundle.description: Case work list with My / My Team scope. Row values come from Case fields.

property.name: showViewAllFooter
property.label: Show View All Footer
property.description: Hides the pager UI and shows a 'Showing X of Y' + View All footer instead, for dashboard-preview placements.

property.name: viewAllUrl
property.label: View All URL
property.description: Site-relative path the View All footer button navigates to, e.g. /work/work.

property.name: showFilterButton
property.label: Show Filter Button
property.description: Shows a Filter button next to the scope toggle (placeholder — not wired to real filter criteria yet).
